A Ritual Design House for Art, Space & Sacred Living

Heka is a multidisciplinary ritual house where art becomes ceremony, and form becomes frequency. We design immersive experiences that span from the intimate to the monumental — using textiles, wax, scent, sound, and symbol as tools for transformation.

From hand-dyed garments to sculptural candles, encaustic installations to sacred interiors — our creations live at the intersection of material and metaphysical. Each project is a living spell, designed not to decorate, but to activate.

We work across mediums — fashion, waxworks, spatial design, and ritual tools — to craft:
Sacred interiors and installations for homes, galleries, and creative spaces
Custom altars and symbolic environments for personal devotion or public experience
Ceremonial objects and clothing infused with archetypes and intentional craft
Events, rites of passage, and energetic space activations
Whether it’s a wedding, an exhibition, a private home, or a piece of wearable magic — every offering is created to shift energy and awaken memory.
